To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the consolidation of sand columns in soft clay can be accelerated using side drains and that the consolidation of the clay surrounding the sand columns can be accelerated using a combination of smear and side drainage.

the effect of smear was found to be more pronounced at lower confining pressure, the rate of consolidation of specimens with and without smear was found to increase with increasing confining pressure, and the effect of smear can be minimized with increase in confining pressure and decrease in smear thickness.
smear zone is an important consideration in consolidation of sand columns installed in soft clay and the use of side drains in the smear zone can accelerate the rate of consolidation of the clay.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of smear zone created around a granular column installed in soft clay and the rate at which the clay consolidates with and without the sand column.
the effect of smear zone on consolidation of clay surrounding sand columns.
the effect of smear zone on consolidation behaviour of clay specimens containing sand drains.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, smear effect has significant impact on consolidation of the sand columns in soft clay.
the presence of smear zone in the clay specimen around the sand column significantly reduces its permeability.
, the smear effect on consolidation of the model sand columns is insignificant.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, the smear zone around the sand columns is a major factor in determining the rate of consolidation of clay specimens with sand columns.
the smear zone is a zone of disturbance that has the effect of increasing the consolidation time of the soil.
the smear effect is significant in soft clay and the effect increases as the confining stress increases.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the smear zone has a negative impact on the rate of consolidation of sand columns.
the smear zone can be effectively created using the method adopted in this study and the consolidation of the sand columns can be accelerated using this method.
the smear zone around the sand columns has an adverse effect on the consolidation of the surrounding soil.
